description.en: Fill a standard job application with your education and experience.
description.ta: உங்கள் கல்வி மற்றும் அனுபவத்துடன் வேலை விண்ணப்பத்தை நிரப்ப.
description.hi: अपनी शिक्षा और अनुभव के साथ नौकरी का आवेदन भरें।
description.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଓ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ସହ ଚାକିରି ଆବେଦନ ଭରନ୍ତୁ।

submit_note: Attach your resume and copies of certificates. Keep the post name and reference number exactly as in the advertisement.

question.en: Which job/post are you applying for? (as written in the advertisement)

fields.explain: Write the post name exactly as in the job advertisement, including any reference number.

question.en: What is your highest qualification? (for example B.Sc Computer Science)

fields.explain: Your highest completed degree or diploma.

question.en: Which college/university, and which year did you pass?
How many years of work experience do you have? Say 0 if you're a fresher.

fields.explain: Total years of paid work. Use decimals for part years, like 2.5.

question.en: Where do you work now (or where did you last work)?

fields.explain: Name of your current or most recent employer.

question.en: What salary do you expect per year?

fields.explain: Give a yearly figure (CTC). You can skip this if the form doesn't require it.

question.en: How many days' notice do you need to give your current employer?

fields.explain: How soon you can join. Say 0 if you can join immediately.
